selection.method: traced target thin dark line, one step of the subject's own nine-step value scale (0.102) darker than both sides, in its darker half (<= 0.490), with a lighter side (a contour, not inside a dark mass); walked through crossings, joined across the tracer's reach, split where it turns back; one nib and one weight per line
